series_note: Original six-friend ensemble comedy in the visual language of a 1990s New York multi-cam sitcom. Scene: the friends discuss the upcoming wedding of Nir'al and Amnon.

look.prompt_string: Cinematic live-action 1990s American ensemble sitcom, shot on 35mm film with medium focal length lenses, warm practical lighting from table lamps and string lights, soft high-key fill with gentle shadows, natural skin texture and real pores, fine film grain, cinematic shallow depth of field, nostalgic warm palette of rust red, ochre, olive green and walnut brown, photographic and slightly faded rather than glossy.
look.prompt_string_short: Cinematic live-action 1990s American ensemble sitcom shot on 35mm, warm practical lamp light, natural skin texture, fine film grain, shallow depth of field, nostalgic warm rust-and-ochre palette, photographic not glossy.

audio_bed.ambience: gentle coffee-shop ambience with low background chatter, an espresso machine hissing softly and cups settling on saucers
audio_bed.laugh: very subtle warm studio audience laughter, low in the mix

avoid: extra characters or background people walking through frame
changing hairstyles, hair color, facial features or wardrobe
distorted or extra hands and fingers
exaggerated cartoonish acting or mugging to camera
modern glossy commercial lighting and heavy color grading
TikTok-style fast cuts, whip pans or handheld shake
on-screen text, subtitles, captions or logos
surreal artifacts, morphing faces or warped furniture
characters speaking at the same time

sets.name: The coffee shop
sets.description: a cozy 1990s New York coffee shop on a weekday afternoon, exposed brick and warm ochre walls, a large rust-red couch facing the open fourth wall, a low walnut coffee table carrying ceramic mugs and a plate of pastries, a mismatched olive armchair at camera-right, a chalkboard menu and espresso bar softly out of focus in the background, warm afternoon light falling through a large street window at camera-left, table lamps and string lights glowing
sets.line_of_action: Couch faces the fourth wall, camera-left to camera-right: Ross, Rachel, Monica (checklist), Chandler, Phoebe. Joey sits alone in the olive armchair at the far camera-right. These positions never change.
sets.description_short: a cozy 1990s New York coffee shop in the afternoon, exposed brick and ochre walls, a large rust-red couch facing the fourth wall, a low walnut table with mugs and a plate of pastries, an olive armchair at camera-right, warm window light from camera-left

scenes.framing: Wide group shot of all six friends around the coffee table, the full couch and the armchair in frame
scenes.performance: A close group of lifelong friends mid-conversation about an upcoming wedding — overlapping warm energy, small gestures, natural eye contact between them, nobody addressing the camera
scenes.image_prompt: Wide eye-level group shot of six friends around a low walnut coffee table in a cozy 1990s New York coffee shop, afternoon light from a street window camera-left, all six mid-conversation, Monica holding a folded paper checklist, a plate of pastries on the table.
timeline: 0-2s the group talks animatedly, Rachel gestures with excitement and Ross nods along
2-4s the camera drifts slowly toward the table, Joey glances down at the plate of pastries, Chandler smirks, Phoebe smiles and settles back in the armchair
4-5s the chatter settles and Monica lifts her checklist and draws breath, about to speak
scenes.sfx: a mug set down on the wooden table
scenes.constraints: all six faces, hair and wardrobe exactly as in the reference frame; seating order and the checklist and pastries on the table unchanged
avoid: any character speaking a clear line of dialogue
anyone standing up or leaving frame

scenes.framing: Medium close-up on Monica seated at the center of the couch, holding a detailed handwritten wedding checklist, the other friends soft and out of focus behind her
scenes.performance: Monica treats organizing this wedding as a military operation — utterly focused, satisfied with her own competence. Natural and comedic, never exaggerated
scenes.image_prompt: Medium close-up of Monica seated center couch holding a handwritten checklist, focused expression, the other five friends softly out of focus behind her, warm afternoon light.
timeline: 0-1s Monica scans the checklist, lips moving slightly
1-6s she looks up and speaks the line evenly, glancing back down at the list on the last word
6-7s she ticks another item with a pen and gives a small satisfied nod

dialogue.line: Okay, flowers, invitations, seating plan, music... everything is under control.

scenes.sfx: the scratch of a pen ticking a box on paper
scenes.constraints: Monica's face, center-parted dark hair and black top exactly as in the reference frame; same handwritten checklist; friends stay seated behind her

scenes.framing: Starts as a close-up on Joey at the camera-right end of the couch, then widens to include Chandler beside him and Monica beyond, all in frame by the end
scenes.performance: Joey is lovable and completely sincere — he genuinely believes this is the most important question in the room. Never stupid or cartoonish. The others react with flat disbelief
scenes.image_prompt: Close-up of Joey at the camera-right end of the couch, leaning slightly forward, suddenly serious, warm afternoon light, coffee shop softly out of focus behind him.
timeline: 0-1s Joey's expression turns abruptly serious and he leans forward
1-3s he asks the question with total sincerity
3-5s a beat of silence as the camera widens to reveal Chandler and Monica staring at him in flat disbelief
scenes.sfx: a small pause in the room chatter
scenes.constraints: Joey's face, swept-back hair and leather jacket exactly as in the reference frame; he stays at the camera-right end of the couch, Chandler to his left

scenes.framing: Starts on Chandler's face beside Joey, then gently widens into a medium group shot taking in Joey, Monica and Rachel reacting
scenes.performance: The humor is entirely in Chandler's deadpan — no smile, no wink. Joey misses the sarcasm completely and takes it as a compliment
scenes.image_prompt: Medium close-up of Chandler seated between Monica and Joey on the couch, dry unimpressed expression turned toward Joey off-frame right, warm afternoon light.
timeline: 0-1s Chandler turns his head to Joey with a completely flat look
1-3s he delivers the line without a flicker of expression
3-4s a beat; Joey smiles proudly, taking it as agreement
4-6s the camera widens as Monica and Rachel start laughing

dialogue.delivery: completely dry and deadpan, no smile
dialogue.line: Of course. The important things first.

scenes.sfx: warm genuine laughter from the friends
scenes.constraints: Chandler's face, forward-combed hair and grey knit vest exactly as in the reference frame; seating order unchanged, Joey at his camera-right

scenes.framing: Medium close-up on Phoebe in the olive armchair at camera-right, the couch soft and out of focus behind her, slowly pushing in
scenes.performance: The room quiets. Phoebe becomes genuinely sincere — warm, unhurried, a little quirky. This is a real emotional moment, not a joke, and it is not played for laughs
scenes.image_prompt: Medium close-up of Phoebe seated in the olive armchair at camera-right, looking around at her friends with a gentle sincere smile, warm afternoon light, couch softly out of focus behind her.
timeline: 0-1s the laughter fades and Phoebe looks slowly around the table
1-4s she speaks the line warmly and unhurriedly as the camera pushes in
4-5s she holds a gentle smile toward her friends

dialogue.delivery: warm, gentle and completely sincere, unhurried
dialogue.line: You know... maybe weddings aren't really about everything being perfect.

scenes.sfx: the room chatter drops noticeably lower
scenes.constraints: Phoebe's face, long ash-blonde hair, floral blouse and lilac cardigan exactly as in the reference frame; she stays in the olive armchair at camera-right

scenes.framing: Close-up on Phoebe in the same armchair, matching the end framing of the previous shot exactly, the friends visible soft and out of focus behind her
scenes.performance: A seamless continuation of the same breath — same warmth, same rhythm, no reset. The friends listen quietly and the beat holds
scenes.image_prompt: Close-up of Phoebe in the olive armchair finishing a heartfelt sentence, gentle sincere expression, the friends soft and out of focus behind her listening, warm afternoon light.
timeline: 0-4s Phoebe finishes her thought without pausing, holding eye contact around the table
4-5s a warm silence: behind her Rachel smiles emotionally, Monica softens, Ross nods slowly, Joey looks genuinely touched and Chandler briefly loses his sarcastic expression

dialogue.delivery: warm, sincere, continuing the same breath as before
dialogue.line: Maybe they're just about finding the person who makes all the chaos feel worth it.

scenes.sfx: quiet room tone, almost no chatter
scenes.constraints: framing, face, hair, wardrobe and lighting identical to the previous Phoebe shot so the two cut together invisibly; same armchair at camera-right
